blocks.text: You can perform the following actions on server agents:

blocks.item: View the Server Agent Registration Token

An agent registration token is a unique key used to register a domain controller with the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal while installing the server agent. After the agent is registered, a session key is generated and used for making subsequent requests with the ITDR Admin Portal.
To obtain the server agent registration token:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
Click View Registration Token.
See image.
In the Token window, copy the token ID and click Done.
See image.

Click Regenerate to reset the token if it is compromised. If you regenerate the token, you cannot use the old token to install the server agent. Make sure to stop any automated installation before generating a new token.
Download a Server Agent

Server agents are installed on domain controllers and continuously monitor Active Directory activity for identity threat detection. You can download the server agent directly from the ITDR Admin Portal.
To download a server agent:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
Click Download Agent.
See image.
In the Download Agent window, choose an OS installation type:
Windows (EXE)
Windows (MSI)
See image.
Click Download Installer.
The latest version of the server agent is downloaded to your system. You can install a server agent on a domain controller.
Export Server Agent Configurations

You can export server agent configuration details as a CSV or JSON file. The configuration details include information about all the installed server agents, or the server agents filtered by the system on which it is installed, the OS version of the system, the server agent version, or the IP address of the server.
Use the search field in the table columns to filter the agents. For example, in the search field of the System Name column, enter the system name to filter agents.
See image.
To export server agents' configuration details:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
Select an option from the Export drop-down menu:
All agents as CSV: Exports the configuration details of all agents as a CSV file.
All agents as JSON: Exports the configuration details of all agents as a JSON file.

These two options allow you to export only the agents that are shown in the table. The table displays only the active server agents. If you want to export all agents including the inactive agents, enable the Show All Agents option from the Actions drop-down menu.
See image.
Filtered agents as CSV: Exports the configuration details of the filtered agents as a CSV file.
Filtered agents as JSON: Exports the configuration details of the filtered agents as a JSON file.
See image.
A CSV or JSON file with the server agent configuration details is downloaded to your local system.
Download Server Agent Logs
To download server agent logs:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
In the Agent details table, select a server agent for which you want to download the logs.
Click Actions > Trigger Logs.
See image.
After 15 minutes, a Download icon appears under the Actions column of the selected server agent.
See image.
To check when the server agent logs were uploaded to the ITDR Admin Portal, hover over the Download icon.
See image.
Click the Download icon.
The server agent logs are downloaded to your local system in a compressed (.zip) file.
Uninstall Server Agents
You can uninstall a single agent, multiple agents, or all server agents from the ITDR Admin Portal.
To uninstall server agents:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
In the Agents table, choose one of the following options:
Select the server agents that you want to uninstall, and then click Actions > Uninstall Selected to uninstall them.
See image.
Click Actions > Uninstall All Agents to uninstall all server agents.
See image.
Click the Uninstall icon under the Actions column to uninstall server agents individually.
See image.
In the Uninstall Agent window, click Uninstall. The server agent tries to remove the policies from the servers for three days, and then it uninstalls itself.
See image.
A confirmation message appears indicating that the agent is uninstalled, and the agent's entry is deleted from the Agents table.
Delete Server Agents
To delete a server agent:
Go to Settings > Server Agent Settings > Agents.
In the Agents table, choose one of the following options:
Select the server agents that you want to delete, and then click Actions > Delete Selected to delete them.
See image.
Click the Delete icon under the Actions column to delete server agents individually.
See image.
When you delete a server agent, its entry is removed from the ITDR Admin Portal only. The agent is not uninstalled from the server.
Server agents cannot be deleted if their Last Seen value is under 7 days.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
See image.
